- group_b (you): verifying the change

submission.body:
Verified the migration of `pull-request`, `final-pull-request`, and `cohort-pull-request` from `src/domain` to `src/forge` and the rule-list refactor over `src/forge/rules.ts`.

Found and fixed one regression in `src/forge/final-pull-request.ts`: `FINAL_RULES` had omitted `rules.mergedWithEvidence("merged observation is missing merged_at evidence")`, which caused merged observations with `merged_at: null` to bypass the mismatch check instead of producing a `pull_request_mismatch` finding as before.

Re-ran `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `bun test`; all 31 tests pass cleanly.
submission.title: Verify src/forge pull-request reconciler migration and restore missing mergedWithEvidence rule in FINAL_RULES
